newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 797 bln lire of Italy CCTs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 797 bln lire of Italy CCTs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 797 billion lire of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 300 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 10.32 trillion lire at the open auction for the May 1, 2004 paper, against three trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.20 from 99.05 at the previous CCT sale on August 30.

Specialists traders also bid for 20 billion lire of 10-year fixed rate government bonds (Btps) compared with 200 billion on offer. At the earlier open auction the Treasury received bids for 2.932 trillion lire against 2.0 trilllion on offer.
The auction price was set at 97.70 compared with 94.65 at the previous auction.
